Dear {vendor} team,

We are writing to dispute charges on our hosting account under {agreement}.

The agreement states: "{cap_clause}" Our prior monthly fee was {prior_monthly}, so the maximum permitted monthly fee for the renewal term is {max_allowed_monthly}.

The following invoices were issued at the higher rate: {invoices}. Each was billed at {charged_monthly} per month, which is an increase of {actual_increase_pct} over the prior term and exceeds the {cap_pct} cap in the agreement. The overcharge is {overcharge_monthly} per month, or {overcharged_to_date} in total to date.

We ask that you issue a credit for the full {overcharged_to_date} overcharged to date, and that you correct our billing so that future invoices do not exceed {max_allowed_monthly} per month for the current term.

Please confirm receipt of this dispute and let us know when the credit and the corrected billing will be applied. We would appreciate a reply within ten business days.

Thank you for your prompt attention to this matter.

Kind regards,
{sender}
